name: Kanojo no Okaa-san wa Suki Desu ka? ~Cool na Hitozuma Shachou o Rouraku Seyo!~
original_name: カノジョのお母さんは好きですか？～クールな人妻社長を籠絡せよ！～
source:
Aoyagi Yoshino wanted to be a pianist when she was young, but she couldn't achieve that dream. Now, she's the president of a company, is married and has a daughter.

Her daughter has talent with the piano too, so Yoshino wants her to become a pianist and achieve the dream that she couldn't. Everything was fine until her daughter got a boyfriend.

Yoshino thinks that having a boyfriend is gonna make her daughter not want to study abroad and her piano dream will fail again. So, Yoshino decides to seduce her daughter's boyfriend in order to make him break up with her.

[Loosely Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=821949]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
青柳芳乃年輕時想成為鋼琴家，卻沒能實現夢想。如今，她是一家公司的社長，已婚並育有女兒。

她的女兒也有鋼琴天賦，因此芳乃希望女兒成為鋼琴家，實現自己未能實現的夢想。一切都很順利，直到女兒交了男朋友。

芳乃認為男朋友會讓女兒放棄留學，鋼琴夢想也會再次失敗。於是，她決定勾引女兒的男朋友，讓他和女兒分手。

［大致譯自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=821949]Getchu[/url]］
